name: Authentication
definition: Data related to the authentication of the cardholder.

AuthenticationMethod.name: Authentication Method
AuthenticationMethod.definition: Method used to authenticate a person.

AuthenticationEntity.name: Authentication Entity
AuthenticationEntity.definition: Entity or object in charge of verifying the person authenticity.

AuthenticationValue.name: Authentication Value
AuthenticationValue.definition: Value used to authenticate the owner of the payment card.

AuthenticationSupport.name: Authentication Support
AuthenticationSupport.definition: This indicator identifies whether person authentication is supported and data is available.

CollectionIndicator.name: Collection Indicator
CollectionIndicator.definition: Identifies in electronic commerce transactions whether customer authentication is supported and data is available.

AuthenticationResult.name: Authentication Result
AuthenticationResult.definition: Specifies the result of the authentication.

Exemption.name: Exemption
Exemption.definition: If Strong Customer Authentication is not mandated to process the transaction, this message element must identify the reason of exemption.

Cardholder.name: Cardholder
Cardholder.definition: Cardholder for which an authentication is provided.

Mandate.name: Mandate
Mandate.definition: Specifies the mandate related to the transport authentication details mandate.
